alerts.header: The platform at Jackson Square is undergoing renovations to improve safety and accessibility. Sections of the platform are unlevel, which may make it difficult for some riders to board and exit trains.
alerts.description: Please see station personnel or use a station call box to request assistance.

alerts.header: Bowdoin Escalator 125 (Lobby to street) is unavailable until further notice, pending replacement.
alerts.description:
The escalator will remain out of service for the foreseeable future. This decision was made after a thorough inspection determined that corrosion on the escalator’s steel truss was so severe that it could not be repaired further and that a complete replacement of the escalator would be required. Replacing the escalator at this location requires a more extended unit meeting modern escalator safety requirements. This longer unit will require significant alteration to the station entrance to meet code requirements. The MBTA has currently begun design work to understand what station upgrades will be needed.

Due to these complexities, we expect the escalator will remain out of service for a significant time. We recognize the challenges this poses to our riders, and please know we are working to identify a solution as quickly as possible. In the meantime, Government Center Station, which is fully accessible and serves the Blue Line, is under a quarter-mile from Bowdoin Station.

Green Line C Branch:  Trains are not stopping at Brandon Hall through October 30 while accessibility upgrades are being done. Riders can board or alight at either Fairbanks St or Summit Ave, which are 0.1-0.2 miles away (or a 4- to 5-minute walk)
Green Line E Branch: Symphony station is closed for major accessibility upgrades. Riders can use Prudential or Northeastern to access E Branch service. The station is expected to reopen in 2029.
alerts.description:
Alternate Service Options:
• Riders who typically board or disembark at Symphony can instead board or disembark at Northeastern University or Prudential, which are 0.3 miles away (or about a five-minute walk) from Symphony.

• Riders are encouraged to instead consider travelling on the Orange Line at Massachusetts Avenue, which is 0.1 miles (or about a three-minute walk) from Symphony.

• Riders may also use the Route 39, which operates parallel to the E branch in both directions along Huntington Avenue.

Background:
Currently, there are no step-free pathways from the entrances to the platforms at Symphony, and the station is not able to be accessed by people with wheeled mobility devices. When construction is complete in spring 2029, Symphony will be enhanced with four new accessible elevators, raised platforms for easier boarding, accessible bathrooms, improved wayfinding, more lighting, and upgraded safety features, making the station safer and easier to use for all riders.

alerts.header: South Station Escalator 388 (Lobby to CSA area) is unavailable due to maintenance.
Downtown Crossing Elevator 869 (Alewife platform to Summer Street Concourse) is unavailable due to maintenance through Tuesday, December 1.
alerts.description:
The elevator is closed for major equipment upgrades that will significantly improve the long-term reliability of this elevator.

To board a Red Line Train: Proceed to the Orange Line Oak Grove Platform at the opposite end of the concourse. Take elevator 998 or 999 to the Red Line passage, then follow signs to Alewife. 
  
To exit the station: Proceed to the north end of the platform to the Orange - Red Line passage. Take Elevator 998 or 999 to the Orange Line Oak Grove platform. Exit the station using the 101 Arch St Elevator on the Summer St concourse.

alerts.header: State Elevator 803 (Forest Hills platform to Washington Street, Milk Street) is unavailable due to maintenance through Tuesday, December 1.
alerts.description:
The elevator is closed for major equipment upgrades that will significantly improve the long-term reliability of this elevator.

To board a Train to Forest Hills: Cross Milk St and go south on Washington St for one-tenth of a mile (two blocks) to the intersection of Washington St and Winter St. Take Downtown Crossing Elevator 892 to the Forest Hills platform. 
 
To board a Train to Oak Grove: Cross Milk St and go south on Washington St for 500 ft (one block) to the intersection of Washington St and Franklin St. Take Downtown Crossing Elevator 891 to the Oak Grove platform. 
 
To exit the station: Go to the end of the Forest Hills platform and continue down the hallway (follow signs for Oak Grove and Blue Line) to the Wonderland platform. At the Wonderland platform, go to the 53 State St lobby and use State Elevator 975 to exit.

To board, go to the Central Ave outbound mini-high platform (to Mattapan). Take a Mattapan-bound trolley to Capen St. Travel to the Capen St inbound mini-high platform.

alerts.header: Broadway Escalator 367 (Platform to paid lobby) is unavailable due to maintenance.
Revere Beach Elevator 885 (Wonderland platform to lobby) is unavailable due to maintenance.
alerts.description: To exit, exit the train at Wonderland, then take a Bowdoin-bound train to Revere Beach and use Revere Beach Elevator 884. To board, use Revere Beach Elevator 884 to access the Bowdoin platform. Take a Bowdoin-bound train to Beachmont, then transfer to a Wonderland-bound train.

alerts.header: Braintree Escalator 334 (Red Line platform to paid lobby) is unavailable due to maintenance.

Green Line C Branch: Trains are skipping Saint Paul Street outbound through Nov 7 for accessibility upgrades. Riders can instead board or disembark one stop away at either Coolidge Corner or Kent Street, which are 0.2 miles away.
alerts.description:

Affected stations:
Saint Paul Street

alerts.header: Wonderland Elevator 711 (Ocean Avenue to pedestrian plaza) is unavailable due to maintenance.
alerts.description: To access Ocean Blvd from the pedestrian plaza, travel along the plaza towards the station and use Wonderland Elevator 710 to access the Wonderland outbound platform. At the platform, exit through the gate and continue along the pathway to Ocean Blvd. To access the pedestrian plaza from Ocean Blvd, travel south on Ocean Blvd for approximately 300 feet, then turn right at the Wonderland pathway. Proceed to the Wonderland platform and use Wonderland Elevator 710.

alerts.header: Back Bay Elevator 854 (Commuter Rail track 2 to lobby) is unavailable.
alerts.description: To exit, exit the train at Ruggles or Forest Hills, then take an Oak Grove-bound train to Back Bay and use Back Bay Elevator 853. To board the Commuter Rail, use Back Bay Elevator 853 to access the Orange Line platform, then take a Forest Hills-bound train to Ruggles or Forest Hills and transfer to the Commuter Rail. Alternatively, board or exit Commuter Rail trains at South Station. Please see station personnel or a train conductor for assistance. In addition, check the Commuter Rail train schedules for train arrival/departure times at Ruggles and Forest Hills by visiting mbta.com/schedules.

alerts.header: Davis Escalator 339 (College Avenue landing to unpaid lobby) is unavailable due to maintenance.
Science Park/West End Elevator 981 (Lechmere & North platform to lobby) is unavailable due to maintenance.
alerts.description: Science Park Elevator 981 (street to Lechmere & North platform) is out of service. Customers desiring to enter the station for Lechmere & North service must use the Copley & West elevator to North Station and transfer to Lechmere & North service to Lechmere. Customers desiring to exit at Science Park must continue to Lechmere and transfer to Copley & West service back to Science Park.

alerts.description: Please see station personnel or a train conductor for assistance. To exit, exit the train at Ruggles or Back Bay, then take a Forest Hills-bound train to Forest Hills and use Forest Hills Elevator 842. To board, use Forest Hills Elevator 842 to access the Orange Line platform, then take an Oak Grove-bound train to Ruggles or Back Bay and transfer to the Commuter Rail. Check the Commuter Rail train schedules for train arrival/departure times at Ruggles and Back Bay by visiting mbta.com/schedules.

Porter Elevator 987 (Red Line platforms to lobby) is unavailable due to maintenance.
alerts.description: Please use nearby Porter Elevator 983 to access the Red Line platforms or lobby.

alerts.header: Haymarket Elevator 907 (Underpass to Oak Grove platform) is unavailable due to maintenance.
alerts.description: To board or exit, use Haymarket Elevator 903 to travel between the Oak Grove platform and the Congress St lobby. To transfer to the Green Line, take Haymarket Elevator 903 to the Congress St lobby, then use Haymarket Elevator 904 to access the Forest Hills platform. At the Forest Hills platform, proceed to the end of platform and take Haymarket Elevator 905 to the Orange Line underpass, then proceed to the end of the hallway and use Haymarket Elevator 906 to access the Green Line platform.

South Station Elevator 926 (Subway Lobby to Atlantic Avenue, Summer Street) is unavailable due to maintenance.
alerts.description: To exit, South Station Elevator 949 located on the opposite side of the lobby. Alternatively, travel up the ramp towards the Commuter Rail Concourse, and at the base of the escalator, turn left and proceed down the hallway. At the end of the hallway, use South Station Elevator 6476 to access the Commuter Rail Concourse. To board, cross Atlantic Ave towards Dewey Sq and use South Station Elevator 949.
